values.note: Suffolk County's online reservation system, with a Green Key login; on 2026-10-21 the county's Reservations page said a new reservation system is 'coming soon' and some services are temporarily unavailable. Reservations 1 to 180 days ahead (no same-day). From May 15 to Oct 15 a reservation must be at least 4 nights if it takes in Thursday-Sunday and 2 nights if Monday-Wednesday only; 2 nights the rest of the season. A reservation made with the $50 Non-Resident Reservation Green Key must be at least 4 nights at any time ('Non-Resident green key card holders may reserve throughout the season for one week maximum, except the following holiday weeks: Memorial Day ... Fourth of July ... Labor Day'). Sites not reserved go to walk-ups from 8 am, paid in full at check-in, at non-resident rates without a Green Key; the rig must be with you. At most 7 nights, then 7 nights away from that campground. Four people or one family (2 adults and their children) per site.

summary: County pages: confirmed phone 631-852-5502, 152 sites (142 basic + 10 water/electric), water at the electric sites; added year-round season (winter camping for self-contained units, when possible) and booking (county system, 180-day window, 2-night minimum / 4 nights Thu-Sun May 15-Oct 15, walk-ups, 7-night max). flags: Non-resident access (the Indian Island / Smith Point drop question): this park does NOT book only through the county system. The county's Campground Rules provide walk-ups: 'Check-in for available walk-up sites will begin at 8:00 am ... Full payment for walk-ups is required at check-in', and 'Campers must have a valid Green Key Card or pay non-resident rates' (https://www.suffolkcountyny.gov/Departments/Parks/Doing-Business/Rules-and-Regulations/Campground-Rules-and-Regulations). The Green Key page's 'When making a camping reservation, it requires the user to make a MINIMUM FOUR NIGHTS stay' covers reservations made with the $50 Non-Resident Reservation Green Key only. So a non-resident can take an unreserved site for a night as a walk-up, or reserve 4+ nights with the $50 key, or reserve at resident rates and resident minimums with the $200 VIP key. Separately, every reservation (residents too) needs 2 nights, 4 when it takes in Thursday-Sunday between May 15 and Oct 15 (recorded in booking.min_stay; the 2-night midweek minimum is the marked kind, under 3).

Household rule: the county camping page says 'Campsite occupancy strictly enforced to a single household residing at same address' and the rules limit a site to 'four (4) individuals or one (1) single family unit (2 adults and their children)'. Not a single-occupancy rule, but a second family cannot share a site.

The county Reservations page (read 2026-10-21) says 'A new Parks Reservation and point-of-sale system is coming soon ... some services are temporarily unavailable'; booking.url (reserveparks.suffolkcountyny.gov, linked from every park page) may change when the new system launches.
